questions.stem: A group of engineers is working on designing a climate control system for a new residential building. They are focusing on ensuring that the indoor environment remains comfortable for the residents throughout the year. They understand that maintaining an appropriate temperature range is crucial for achieving thermal comfort. Which of the following temperature ranges is generally considered comfortable for indoor environments?

options.label: A
options.text: Corrected effective temperature between 25-27 deg Celsius.

options.label: B
options.text: Corrected effective temperature between 20-25 deg Celsius

options.label: C
options.text: Corrected effective temperature between 10-22 deg Celsius

options.label: D
options.text: Corrected effective temperature between 20-23 deg Celsius
